ex: The announcement caused a lot of confusion.
该公告引起了很多混乱。

en: to prove a person or an argument to be wrong

zh: 康茄鼓（用手击打的狭长鼓）
en: a fast dance in which the dancers follow a leader in a long winding line, with each person holding on to the person in front; a piece of music for this dance
to become thick or solid
ex: The cold remains of supper had congealed on the plate.
晚餐剩下的冷饭菜已经凝结在盘子上了。

en: having become thick or solid
ex: congealed blood
凝固了的血

zh: 意气相投的；志趣相投的；合得来的
en: pleasant to spend time with because their interests and character are similar to your own
ex: a congenial colleague
意气相投的同事

en: existing since or before birth
ex: congenital abnormalities
先天畸形

en: in a way that has existed since or before birth
ex: The research involved people who are either congenitally blind or who lost their sight before age 4.
这项研究的对象是先天失明或在4岁之前失明的人。

en: a large eel (= a long thin fish) that lives in the sea

zh: 拥挤的；挤满的；（交通）堵塞的
en: crowded; full of traffic
ex: congested city streets
交通拥塞的城市街道

en: the state of being crowded and full of traffic
ex: traffic congestion and pollution
交通拥塞和污染

zh: 交通拥塞费，进城费（为缓解市中心塞车状况而收取）
en: an amount of money that people have to pay for driving their cars into the centre of some cities as a way of stopping the city centre from becoming too full of traffic

zh: 交通拥塞费，进城费（为缓解市中心塞车状况而收取）
en: the policy of making people pay an amount of money for driving their cars into the centre of some cities as a way of stopping the city centre from becoming too full of traffic
a large company formed by joining together different firms
ex: He turned the business into a huge media conglomerate.
他令公司成为一个庞大的大众传媒联合集团。

en: a mixture of different things that are found all together
ex: a conglomeration of buildings of different sizes and styles
大小和风格各异的建筑楼群
